card.title: Sd Kfz 10 PAK 38
card.text: Gets +1 attack until end of turn if another card increases the attack of this unit.
card.flavorText: The Sd.Kfz. 10 PaK 38 was a German half-track adapted during WWII to mount the 5cm PaK 38 anti-tank gun, giving infantry units a mobile anti-tank capability. The Sd.Kfz. 10 chassis was originally designed to tow light artillery, but this field modification involved fitting the more powerful PaK 38 gun directly onto the vehicle. The Sd.Kfz. 10 was powered by a 6-cylinder Maybach engine and equipped with half-tracks for improved off-road performance. It retained space for a small crew and ammunition, making it well-suited for hit-and-run attacks and mobile defense. While not a standardized production model, the Sd.Kfz. 10 PaK 38 reflected the German Army’s adaptability in addressing the growing threat of better-armored Allied tanks.
